#image("/imgs/ap-calc-bc-2002-form-b-frq-03-diagram-01.jpg", width: 65%)

Let $R$ be the region in the first quadrant bounded by the $y$-axis and the graphs of $y = 4 x - x^(3)+ 1$ and $y = frac(3,4) x$.

(a) Find the area of $R$.

(b) Find the volume of the solid generated when $R$ is revolved about the $x$-axis.

(c) Write an expression involving one or more integrals that gives the perimeter of $R$. Do not evaluate.
